cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make It Official
cards.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've made you Keeper of the Festival Lantern.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said I'd hold it while you tied your shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. An excellent probationary performance. Here's your badge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until you find a qualified successor. The lantern must never be abandoned.
